message:
♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.2.0 IS LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

Version 9.2.0 is a big upgrade to SS To AE: it now reads photo and gradient backgrounds, JPEG screenshots and phone screenshots properly, and splits cards, dialogs and icons into cleaner layers. It also fixes the Silence Remover's layout.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart After Effects once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **SS To AE 2.3 (FX & ADV RIGS)**
* **Photo & Gradient Backgrounds:** Screenshots with a photo, wallpaper or mesh-gradient background no longer turn into dozens of junk layers. You get the text, buttons and cards, and the background comes through as its own layer.
* **JPEG, WebP & HEIC Screenshots:** Compression noise is cleaned up automatically, so images saved from the web or chat apps now detect almost as well as a PNG. WebP files can be picked directly.
* **Phone Screenshots:** 2x and 3x iPhone and Android screenshots are read at the right size, so bold words no longer fall apart.
* **Outlined & Glass Cards:** A card drawn with just a thin border, or a glass card over a wallpaper, comes out as one card with its contents inside.
* **Cleaner Layers:** A dialog touching the content behind it is separated from it, gradient headlines stay in one piece, icons next to labels get their own layers, and cards inside a grey column no longer disappear.

♦️ **Silence Remover Fix**
* **Clean Jump-Cuts:** The cut pieces now sit in time order, top to bottom, exactly back-to-back on whole frames, instead of stacking out of order. A camera and a mic that start at different times now stay in sync after the cut.

♦️ **Coming From An Older Version?**
* This update also includes everything from 9.1.9: SaaS Effects, Templates 2.0, the Stagger and Multi text sets, and the Silence Remover.
